item.title: WA's minimum wage is going up in 2026. Here's how much
item.description: Washington’s minimum wage will increase 2.8% to $17.13 an hour starting Jan. 1, 2026, the highest statewide rate in the U.S., with changes also affecting overtime-exempt salaries, rideshare drivers, and non-compete thresholds.

item.title: How to watch New Year's Eve fireworks in Seattle
item.description: The New Year's at the Needle celebration is expected to draw big crowds on the eve of 2026. Here's how to watch and stream the display live.

item.title: Deadly crash shuts down traffic at South Tacoma Way on Monday
item.description: At least one person is dead following a crash along a busy Tacoma roadway on Monday. Authorities announced hours of traffic closures to investigate the scene.

item.title: Running game rounding into form for Seattle Seahawks as they pursue No. 1 seed
item.description: An Achilles heel most of the season, the rushing attack of the Seattle Seahawks has been on the upswing in recent weeks as the team chases the No. 1 seed in the NFC.

item.title: AI videos, conspiracy claims muddy reality after South King County flooding
item.description: Kent Mayor Dana Ralph says AI videos depicting false flooding scenes in southern King County complicated emergency response efforts.

item.title: South Hill, WA neighbors recall deadly shooting involving deputies
item.description: A man is dead, and an independent investigation has been launched, after Pierce County deputies shot him in South Hill on Monday morning.

item.title: Seattle woman finds hidden cameras aimed at her home
item.description: A Beacon Hill woman says she found a hidden, camouflaged camera aimed at her front door — and weeks later believes a second attempt involved two men and a possible Wi-Fi jammer.

item.description: The Seahawks are sitting on top of the NFC West, and a win Saturday could make the path to the Super Bowl much smoother.

item.title: Seattle weather: Pockets of freezing fog by Tuesday morning
item.description: A weak ridge of high pressure will keep our cool, dry days through the end of the year. Light showers will return to kick off the new year.
